scripts.check:all: yarn check:crypto && yarn build:wasm && yarn check:sdk && yarn check:i18n && yarn check:email-templates
scripts.check:sdk: yarn check:sdk:id && yarn check:sdk:types && yarn check:sdk:import && yarn check:sdk:api && yarn check:sdk:auth && yarn check:sdk:vault && yarn check:sdk:sync && yarn check:sdk:ui
scripts.build:ts-sdk: yarn tsc -p packages/id/tsconfig.json && yarn tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && yarn tsc -p packages/sync/tsconfig.json
scripts.fuzz:crypto:quick: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN="${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" rustup toolchain install "${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" --profile minimal && cd rust/crypto-engine && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo +"${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" fuzz run hybrid_decode -- -seed=1337 -max_total_time=20 && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo +"${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" fuzz run hybrid_decrypt -- -seed=1338 -max_total_time=20 && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo +"${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" fuzz run signature_verify -- -seed=1339 -max_total_time=20
scripts.fuzz:crypto:extended: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN="${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" rustup toolchain install "${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" --profile minimal && cd rust/crypto-engine && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo +"${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" fuzz run hybrid_decode -- -seed=202601 -max_total_time=300 && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo +"${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" fuzz run hybrid_decrypt -- -seed=202602 -max_total_time=300 && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo +"${RUST_NIGHTLY_TOOLCHAIN:-nightly-2026-03-20}" fuzz run signature_verify -- -seed=202603 -max_total_time=300
scripts.dev: yarn build:email && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "yarn dev:api:serve" "yarn dev:web"
scripts.dev:worker: echo 'TODO: add worker dev command' && exit 1
scripts.test: yarn test:api && yarn test:security && yarn test:e2e && yarn test:web
scripts.test:api: yarn build:wasm && yarn build:ts-sdk && yarn build:email && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 services/api/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:crypto:property: yarn build:wasm && node --test packages/crypto/test/hybrid.property.test.mjs packages/crypto/test/secret-buffer.test.mjs && cargo test --locked --manifest-path rust/crypto-engine/Cargo.toml property_tests
scripts.test:crypto:contracts: yarn build:wasm && node --test packages/crypto/test/hybrid.contracts.test.mjs && cargo test --locked --manifest-path rust/crypto-engine/Cargo.toml hybrid_golden_layout_sha256_matches_cross_layer_fixture
scripts.test:security: yarn build:wasm && yarn build:ts-sdk && yarn build:email && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=180000 services/api/test/security-qday-downgrade-strip.test.ts services/api/test/security-qday-missing-pq-malformed-envelope.test.ts services/api/test/security-qday-mixed-device-replay-rollback.test.ts
